governance.decisionForum: During light-touch Year One mobilisation, material decisions can continue through the King’s Edge Portfolio Board, with deliberate assurance and referral to relevant Digital and IT product, architecture, data, assurance and service governance where formal authority is required. Dedicated cross-institution Student Experience Hub governance should be established before the programme moves into deeper cross-service mobilisation.
governance.decisionScope: Material decisions about the Student Experience Hub product direction; the outcomes and evidence required from broad 2026/27 discovery; the focused September 2027 first live release and any refinement of its current service hypotheses; the common home and shared app foundations; the boundary between the Hub’s student-facing enquiry gateway and the separately delivered enquiry-management capability; any proposal to deepen a non-Edge integration where this would create material new effort; sequencing; platform investment and operating costs; readiness for the first live release; the evidence used to select later end-to-end journeys; the transition into dedicated cross-institution governance; and enduring product, platform and service ownership.
governance.businessAsUsualOwner: TBC within Students and Education Directorate (SED) – enduring student-facing Hub product owner
governance.businessAsUsualOwnershipNote: Mark Peace leads mobilisation and maturation of the Student Experience Hub. As the Hub transitions into business as usual, accountable ownership of the student-facing product should move into SED, with Digital and IT retaining technical/platform ownership and the engineering capability that sustains it. The exact enduring SED role can be settled as the operating model matures. Initial Year One governance remains proportionate to the light-touch scope, but the first year should provide enough assurance over the emerging proposition, architecture, dependencies and roadmap to support establishment of a dedicated cross-institution governance structure before deeper service integration and rationalisation begin.
